newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wharf Holdings mulls Yankee bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Wharf Holdings mulls Yankee bond issue.

text.p: Wharf Holdings is considering accessing funds via the U.S. Yankee bond market, Nick Thompson, head of corporate affairs, said on Friday.
"We believe this is a good time to look at a Yankee issue," Thompson told Reuters.
Roadshows for the proposed bond issue begin on Friday in Hong Kong. No details of the bond's size, tenor or pricing have been set, Thompson said.
U.S. investors typically prefer issues with very long maturities.
Market sources said Merrill Lynch has been appointed lead manager and bookrunner, while HSBC Markets and J.P. Morgan will act as co-leads.
Bond issues for Hong Kong and China borrowers have traded very well in international markets over the last several months, traders said.
